config.methodology: skill over persistence + base-rate baselines on same confirmed turns (apples-to-apples)
config.evaluatedAt: per-signal lead (locked headline rule from detection engine)
config.persistenceMethod: predict rent YoY moves same direction as trailing 3mo YoY change; persistence p̂ = 0.5 + 0.40 × min(1, |trend pp| / 2)
config.baseRateMethod: in-sample climatology — predict majority realized direction across all judged turns; p̂ = sample fraction of majority class
config.brierFormula: BS = mean((p̂ − y)²) where y = 1 if hit, 0 otherwise
config.bssFormula: BSS = 1 − BS_engine / BS_baseline   (BSS > 0 ⇒ engine has skill)
config.skillFormula: skill = engine hit rate − baseline hit rate (in percentage points)
config.notes: Persistence is the key competitor: if BSS_vsPersistence ≤ 0 or skill_vsPersistence ≤ 0, the engine has no demonstrated skill over a naive trend-continuation forecast. Report as-is.
